name: boundary-engine
description: BoundaryEngine is a Fetch-first route boundary toolkit for TypeScript with typed validation, guard pipelines, sanitized errors, webhook protection, and request identity helpers.
author: Christian Paul (https://github.com/cpauldev)

scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:smoke: node --input-type=module -e "const mod = await import('./dist/index.js'); for (const key of ['ApiError','createErrorFactory','sanitizeError','validateJsonBody','validateQueryParams','createRouteBoundary','createBoundaryErrorHandler','json','empty','errorJson','verifyWebhookSignature','validatePayloadSize','createWebhookGuard','getClientIp']) { if (typeof mod[key] !== 'function') throw new Error('Missing export: ' + key); }"
